description: Story chapters and world-changing events for Lumora. Inspired by dynamic progression like Crimson Desert. Completing a chapter resolves the event and permanently alters the world state until future events.

ch1_awakening.name: The Awakening
ch1_awakening.description: Player starts in the meadow, basic tutorial.

ch3_demon_summon.name: The Demon Summon
ch3_demon_summon.description: A meteor-like breach summons a demon in the main hub city. The city is under siege, exits blocked, dangers everywhere. Must complete the chapter to restore access and safety.

city_demon_summon.description: A rift opens in the city plaza. A demon is summoned. The city gates are sealed by the chaos. Players must gather allies or power in other zones, then return to banish it.
